brief:
The National Assembly of Palestinian Tribes and Clans announced Saturday that it had secured the return of 10 Palestinian families held as hostages in the Yellow Line area, in coordination with relevant security agencies. The families, detained by gangs operating in cooperation with Israeli forces, have been released and returned to their home areas and relatives.

The assembly did not disclose details about how long the families were held, the specific conditions of their captivity, or the negotiations that facilitated their release. The Yellow Line designation typically refers to a buffer zone or disputed territory in Palestinian areas. The exact location and circumstances surrounding the detention remained unclear from the announcement.
